apps.localizedDescription:
更新投屏依赖 https://github.com/bggRGjQaUbCoE/PiliPlus/issues/2680#issuecomment-6597938908
修复部分视频评论显示不全 #3458

修复 macOS 关闭系统标题栏后无法拖动 #3453 by @NalCol
